dsDescriptionValue.value: Blog post about the "anniversary" of the coniation of the word ageism, https://euroageism.eu/policy_projects/50-years-of-ageism/ One day I entered a room, as a researcher, conducting data collection in a company. I was wearing a pantsuit and I was setting up cameras for data recording. Two men entered the room, both of them clearly older than me. I explained to them the aim of the study, the privacy related to the data collection and handed them the informed form. I was leaving the room, when one of the man, already sitting at the table, called me “the girl”. I remembered that I introduced myself to him and I remembered that other people, in the same context, referred to me as “the researcher” or “the doctor”. I felt offended and not respected in my role, I clearly felt that it has something to do with my age, and also, my gender.

datasetVersion.citation: Federica Previtali et al, 2019,  50 Years of Ageism, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6513379
